recentItems.title: An Idea for Shared Development
recentItems.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has just wrapped up visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, during which he also attended a Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek.
The grand ceremonies, major agreements and joint statements drew plenty of attention. But one keyword kept coming up throughout the trip: #AI.

recentItems.title: High-level trust drives Egypt-China partnership forward: expert
recentItems.description:
"Egyptian-Chinese relations are characterized by a high level of trust between the leaders of the two countries, deep friendship, shared interests, and mutual benefits," said Ezzat Saad, director of the Egyptian Council for Foreign Affairs.
From the #BeltAndRoad Initiative to #BRICS and #SCO, this model partnership aligns closely on global initiatives to champion the development of the #GlobalSouth and advance a multipolar world, said the expert. #Egypt #China #BRI

recentItems.title: Ancient wells fuel cold-water fish farming in China's Xinjiang
recentItems.description: Cold-water fish farming is sustained by two-millennia-old wells that keep water at 15 to 19 degrees Celsius year-round in Turpan in northwest China's Xinjiang, one of the world's driest and hottest places.

recentItems.title: Tour Ancient Egypt in One Minute [4K]
recentItems.description:
Ancient #Egypt left behind more wonders than anyone could count, and the Grand Egyptian #Museum comes remarkably close.
Join us for a whirlwind tour through 5,000 years of #history, faster than you can say #Tutankhamun. #Pharaohs, #pyramids and everything in between, all in one minute.
